relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: An increase in the transient receptor potential vanilloid type-1 receptor (TRPV1), which stimulates the release of CGRP and substance P, is observed in chronic migraine patients.

key_findings: Review: BT-A cleaves SNAP-25 to block acetylcholine release and also inhibits release of CGRP, substance P and glutamate from sensory neurons.
BT-A may reduce TRPV1 membrane delivery, contributing to analgesia in migraine and neuropathic pain.
